ruins.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Original transparent environment sprites for a top-down 2D 16-bit fantasy/technology adventure RPG matching richly detailed chibi heroes, shaded mossy island cottages and ivory/steel science buildings. Polished SNES-style pixel art with crisp clustered pixels, dark readable outlines, carefully shaded facets and upper-left highlights. NOT vector, not low-detail block art, not photorealistic 3D. Front-facing overhead three-quarter RPG projection, NOT isometric. Genuine transparent alpha background, generous transparent gaps, no labels, no writing, no characters, no ground shadows. THREE separate reusable scenery pieces in an atlas arranged in ONE HORIZONTAL ROW with generous transparent gaps: LEFT a flat square ancient mossy stone floor patch viewed straight down with chipped grey-green sandstone slabs, cracks, tiny vines and grass between tiles, width and height equal, no walls or raised elements on this floor patch. MIDDLE a single LOW straight ruined sandstone wall section, broad horizontal silhouette width about four times height, carved block joints, green moss, cracked capstones, pale sage highlights and deep shaded front face. RIGHT one LOW straight ruined wall running vertically north-south, narrow silhouette height about four times width with similarly mossy cracked capstones visible from above. Each piece stands alone, fully visible, no connecting walls, no full building, no archways. Camera and material consistent with an explorable ruined courtyard in a detailed pixel RPG; low walls must not look like huge towers.
